title: Assigned to me shows only the groups that hold my work
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. In Tech View.
custom_steps:
1. Switch to Tech View.
  2. Enable Assigned to me.
  3. Confirm the Unassigned group is hidden.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With Assigned to me enabled, Tech View shows only the technician groups (including Unassigned) that hold at least one work order matching Assigned to me.
  • Every other group is hidden, including pinned technicians.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10045 — Tech View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S2-R9 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
